source: Armagedom origin/main Web/public/assets/roach/original-roach.glb (27-bone 'roach rig': root > body > thorax > head, abdomen, 3 leg pairs of leg > shin > foot; skin has 27 joints). World rest position of every bone, from the GLB node JSON only (translations and rotations composed down the parents, no mesh read). Model units, before the x3 model scale the game applies (data/bodies/roach.chain.json scale). The creature faces +z, stands on y = 0, left bones are at -x. Measured 2026-10-28: every one of the 27 positions equals the spider rig's to 1e-3, so the roach and the spider share one skeleton and differ only in the skin.
units: glb model units (metres before the game's model scale)

abdomen_tip.note: not a model bone: the abdomen bone has no child, so its capsule needs an end point. Placeholder 0.14 model units behind the abdomen bone (a roach abdomen is shorter than a spider's); the GLB mesh is int16-quantised and was not decoded, so this is a guess to correct against a still.

head_tip.note: not a model bone: the end of the head capsule, level with the mandible tips (z 0.21) and just short of the antennae (0.225).
